question: Does the identity-proved clean current-main trace provide robust same-fight Ward and Warden's-Edge draw opportunity, and at which measured boundary is natural co-play lost?

trace.selectionRule: Read the complete sole 256-row draw-telemetry explicit-null arm. No row or identity is selected by an endpoint.

cohort.identity: The exact full-cohort policy and simulation seed identities from the identity preflight are reused. No simulator executes and no identity is added, removed or replaced.

routeDefinitions.drawOpportunityRow: Within at least one fight, both a Ward card instance (defend) and Warden's Edge (guardedStrike) are drawn at any event positions.
routeDefinitions.drawOpportunityPolicy: At least two of four frozen rows are draw-opportunity rows.
routeDefinitions.coPlayRow: Within at least one fight, Ward and Warden's Edge are both played in either order.
routeDefinitions.coPlayPolicy: At least two of four frozen rows are co-play rows.
routeDefinitions.naturalOrderRow: Within at least one fight, Ward is played before a later Warden's Edge.
routeDefinitions.naturalOrderPolicy: At least two of four frozen rows are natural-order rows.

scorelinePayoff.status: Separate fixed causal factor; not varied or estimated.

afterimagePayoff.status: Separate fixed causal factor; not varied or estimated.

wardSetupPriority.status: Fixed exact current-main combat policy; no research knob exists.

observedBoundary.status: Ordered necessary-condition observations on the same frozen rows, not causal factors.

interactionsAndAliases.mechanisticNesting: Natural order is a subset of co-play, and co-play must be a subset of same-fight draw opportunity. The runner fails closed if either relationship is violated.
interactionsAndAliases.drawAlias: Same-fight draw opportunity is an upper bound on simultaneous hand or legal-action availability because the two cards may be drawn on different turns. Therefore a passing draw gate with a failing co-play gate does not by itself isolate policy selection; it leaves within-fight temporal availability and play selection aliased.
interactionsAndAliases.correction: The earlier observability preflight's broad interpretation that a passing same-fight draw gate would isolate downstream play selection is not used. This preregistration freezes the scientifically narrower upper-bound interpretation before aggregate draw counts are read.
interactionsAndAliases.noExpansion: No payoff, acquisition, rarity, Ward-priority, candidate, optimiser or joint cell exists. Counts cannot unlock a Cartesian experiment.

estimands.primary: Exact count and identities of robust same-fight draw-opportunity policies.
estimands.lossBoundaries: Exact draw-but-not-co-play and co-play-but-not-natural-order policy sets.
estimands.consistency: Exact nesting of natural order within co-play within the same-fight draw upper bound, plus exact reproduction of the prior co-play and natural-order counts.
estimands.reliability: Exact stall or error row count.
estimands.notEstimated: No simultaneous hand availability, legal-action set, causal effect, Afterimage or Scoreline payoff, candidate feasibility, detector, product balance, ML, RL or optimisation endpoint is estimated.

gates.provenance: The 16-policy minima reuse the frozen 64-policy support scale from the current-main topology audit. They are not weakened after observing the prior co-play count of 13.

factorDisposition.candidate: None. An observation boundary cannot freeze or promote content.
factorDisposition.scalarFamily: Remains closed; no payoff, Ward-priority or acquisition cell is reopened.
factorDisposition.additionalMethod: No ML, RL, optimiser or fitted model is used. Only an isolated policy-action-order failure after draw and co-play capacity pass could justify a separate zero-row method decision-value audit.
factorDisposition.protectedSeeds: Acceptance and reserve seeds remain unused.

executionAndStopping.construction: Deterministic Python verifies every frozen file and cache, maps the complete plan to output, computes all three nested robust policy sets once and applies the frozen gates.
executionAndStopping.firstLook: The complete 64-policy by four-seed trace is the only look. No row is generated, repaired, added, removed or rerun.
executionAndStopping.successStop: Stop only if draw opportunity, co-play, natural order and reliability all pass.
executionAndStopping.futilityStop: Stop at the first failed mechanistic boundary in draw, co-play, natural-order, reliability order without weakening a gate.
executionAndStopping.inconclusiveStop: Stop at 30 seconds if the fixed exact decision is unavailable.

decisionRules.success: All draw-opportunity, co-play, natural-order and reliability gates pass within 30 seconds.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply decision boundary 1 and freeze only natural route capacity as evidence for a separate zero-row structural mechanism audit. Do not freeze a candidate or add a causal row, payoff, knob, ML, RL or optimiser.
decisionRules.futility: Any frozen gate fails at the complete cohort.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply decision boundary 2 and close natural Afterimage-route capacity at the recorded first mechanistic failure. Continue inside issue #421 with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism. If the failure is the aliased temporal-or-selection class, only a separately preregistered minimal existing-event observability audit is authorised; no method is authorised.
decisionRules.inconclusive: A frozen cache, protocol or exact decision is unavailable at the 30-second cap.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply decision boundary 3 and record the decomposition inconclusive. Add no field, row, repair, rerun, candidate, method or protected seed.
